sections.heading: What Plants Do
sections.body: Plants make their own food. They use sunlight to do this. This process is called photosynthesis.
sections.visual_hint: diagram of a plant using sunlight

sections.heading: What Plants Need
sections.body: Plants need three things to make food. They need sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide. Carbon dioxide is a gas in the air.
sections.visual_hint: diagram showing sun, water, and air going into a plant

sections.heading: What Plants Make
sections.body: Plants make glucose. Glucose is a type of sugar. Plants also make oxygen. Oxygen is the gas we breathe.
sections.visual_hint: diagram showing glucose and oxygen coming out of a plant

sections.heading: Where It Happens
sections.body: Photosynthesis happens in the leaves. Leaves have a green pigment called chlorophyll. Chlorophyll catches sunlight.
sections.visual_hint: close-up diagram of a leaf showing chlorophyll

key_terms.definition: how plants make food from sunlight
green pigment in leaves that catches sunlight
a type of sugar that plants make
a gas in the air that plants need
